name: afterglow CLI
description: The headless `afterglow` command line tool: drives every app's command catalog on files with no window (`afterglow <app> <command> --json '{…}'`, open, export, list-commands, describe) and runs `*.jobs.json` scripts over sets of input files, which are also the real-jobs suites. One JSON object on stdout per run, sysexits exit codes. AfterGlowCLICore holds the router and every route, testable in process; AfterGlowCLI is the thin executable (product `afterglow`). Builds and runs on Linux, so cloud leads and CI drive the apps through it (docs/blueprints/suite/features/afterglow-cli.md).
